premise: Beaver's gnawing sends chips flying over Hedgehog, who curls up in a huff; but Bird needs twigs for his nest, Beaver's just-right gnawing makes the perfect ones, and the chips make Hedgehog a soft bed.
inspiration: The Belly and the Members (Aesop), turned: the noisy work everyone grumbles about is what everyone needs — with a Goldilocks "just right" running through it.
lesson: The thing that bothers you may be the thing that helps.
learning: A beaver's front teeth never stop growing, so it gnaws wood to keep them short.

en-US.title: Beaver Gnaws Just Right
en-US.text: Chomp, chomp, CHOMP! {beaver:enter} Beaver was at it again. {beaver:live gnaw} He gnawed his stick {sfx:chomp} and chips flew everywhere… right onto {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to beaver} Hedgehog, who was trying to nap. {hedgehog:face sad} "Hmph!" {hedgehog:live curl hold} He curled up in a prickly huff. [curious] "Why do you ALWAYS gnaw?" {beaver:face surprised} {beaver:wobble} "Because my teeth never stop growing," said Beaver. "If I didn't gnaw, they'd grow down to my toes!" Just then {bird:enter} {bird:go to beaver} Bird fluttered down. {bird:face sad} [sad] "I need twigs for my nest, but mine are all too long." {beaver:face happy} [excited] "Leave it to me!" {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:chomp} Chomp, chomp, chomp: twigs, just right. {bird:face happy} {bird:hop x2} "Perfect!" {bird:go to branches} Up flew Bird with his twigs, high into the branches, and {bird:live sing} {sfx:birdsong} sang his thanks. Down below, the chomping had stopped, and {hedgehog:live curl resume} Hedgehog peeked out. All round him lay Beaver's chips, soft and curly. {hedgehog:face happy} "Hmm," he said. "Just right." "Chomp, chomp?" asked Beaver. [warmly] "Chomp away," said Hedgehog. {hedgehog:face sleeping} And he {hedgehog:live sleep hold} snuggled down for the softest nap of all.

es-ES.title: El ñac, ñac de Castor
es-ES.text: ¡Ñac, ñac, ÑAC! {beaver:enter} Castor ya estaba otra vez. {beaver:live gnaw} Roía su palo {sfx:chomp} y las virutas saltaban por todas partes… justo encima de {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to beaver} Erizo, que intentaba echarse la siesta. {hedgehog:face sad} —¡Jum! {hedgehog:live curl hold} Se hizo una bola, enfurruñadísimo. [curious] —¿Por qué te pasas el día ROYENDO? {beaver:face surprised} {beaver:wobble} —Porque los dientes no me paran de crecer —dijo Castor—. ¡Si no royera, me llegarían hasta los pies! En eso, {bird:enter} {bird:go to beaver} Pájaro bajó revoloteando. {bird:face sad} [sad] —Necesito ramitas para mi nido, pero las mías son larguísimas. {beaver:face happy} [excited] —¡Déjamelo a mí! {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:chomp} Ñac, ñac, ñac: ramitas a la medida. {bird:face happy} {bird:hop x2} —¡Perfectas! {bird:go to branches} Pájaro subió volando a las ramas con sus ramitas y {bird:live sing} {sfx:birdsong} cantó para darle las gracias. Allí abajo dejó de oírse el ñac, ñac, y {hedgehog:live curl resume} Erizo asomó el hocico. Alrededor tenía un montón de virutas blanditas y rizadas. {hedgehog:face happy} —Mmm —dijo—. Justo a la medida. —¿Ñac, ñac? —preguntó Castor. [warmly] —Ñac, ñac todo lo que quieras —dijo Erizo. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Y {hedgehog:live sleep hold} se acurrucó para la siesta más blandita del mundo.

ja-JP.title: ビーバーくんの カリカリ
ja-JP.text: カリカリ、カリカリ、カリッ！{beaver:enter}ビーバーくんが、またかじっています。{beaver:live gnaw}ぼうをかじると、{sfx:chomp}木くずがぱらぱら…{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to beaver}おひるねしたいハリネズミくんの上に。{hedgehog:face sad}「むむっ！」 {hedgehog:live curl hold}ぷんぷん、まるくなってしまいました。[curious]「どうして、いつもかじるの？」 {beaver:face surprised}{beaver:wobble}「まえばが、ずっとのびつづけるからさ」 とビーバーくん。「かじらないと、足までのびちゃう！」 そこへ{bird:enter}{bird:go to beaver}ことりが、ぱたぱたおりてきました。{bird:face sad}[sad]「すづくりのぼうが、ぜんぶ長すぎるんだ。」 {beaver:face happy}[excited]「まかせて！」 {beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:chomp}カリカリカリ…ちょうどいいぼうのできあがり。{bird:face happy}{bird:hop x2}「ぴったり！」 {bird:go to branches}ことりはぼうをくわえて、高いえだへ。{bird:live sing}{sfx:birdsong}ありがとうの歌をうたいました。下では、カリカリの音がやんで、{hedgehog:live curl resume}ハリネズミくんがかおを出しました。まわりには、ふわふわくるくるの木くず。{hedgehog:face happy}「ふむ。ちょうどいい。」 「カリカリ、してもいい？」 とビーバーくん。[warmly]「どうぞ、カリカリ」 とハリネズミくん。{hedgehog:face sleeping}そして{hedgehog:live sleep hold}もぐりこんで、いちばんふかふかのおひるね。

de-DE.title: Der Biber knabbert genau richtig
de-DE.text: Knabber, knabber, KNACK! {beaver:enter} Der Biber war wieder dabei. {beaver:live gnaw} Er nagte an seinem Stock, {sfx:chomp} und die Späne flogen überallhin… genau auf {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to beaver} den Igel, der gerade schlafen wollte. {hedgehog:face sad} „Hmpf!“ {hedgehog:live curl hold} Beleidigt rollte er sich zur Stachelkugel ein. [curious] „Warum musst du IMMER nagen?“ {beaver:face surprised} {beaver:wobble} „Weil meine Zähne nie aufhören zu wachsen“, sagte der Biber. „Wenn ich nicht nage, wachsen sie mir bis zu den Zehen!“ Da kam {bird:enter} {bird:go to beaver} der Vogel heruntergeflattert. {bird:face sad} [sad] „Ich brauche Zweige für mein Nest, aber meine sind alle zu lang.“ {beaver:face happy} [excited] „Überlass das mir!“ {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:chomp} Knabber, knabber, knabber: Zweige, genau richtig. {bird:face happy} {bird:hop x2} „Perfekt!“ {bird:go to branches} Der Vogel flog mit seinen Zweigen hoch hinauf in die Äste und {bird:live sing} {sfx:birdsong} sang ein Dankeschön. Unten hatte das Knabbern aufgehört, und {hedgehog:live curl resume} der Igel lugte hervor. Rings um ihn lagen die Späne vom Biber, weich und lockig. {hedgehog:face happy} „Hm“, sagte er. „Genau richtig.“ „Knabber, knabber?“, fragte der Biber. [warmly] „Knabber nur zu“, sagte der Igel. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Und er {hedgehog:live sleep hold} kuschelte sich hinein – für das allerweichste Schläfchen.

fr-FR.title: Le cric-crac de Castor
fr-FR.text: Cric, crac, CROC ! {beaver:enter} Castor remettait ça. {beaver:live gnaw} Il rongeait son bâton {sfx:chomp} et les copeaux volaient partout… même sur {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to beaver} Hérisson, qui faisait la sieste. {hedgehog:face sad} « Hmpf ! » {hedgehog:live curl hold} Il s’est mis en boule. [curious] « Pourquoi tu ronges TOUJOURS ? » {beaver:face surprised} {beaver:wobble} « Parce que mes dents poussent sans arrêt, a dit Castor. Sans ça, elles me descendraient jusqu’aux pieds ! » Alors, {bird:enter} {bird:go to beaver} Oiseau est descendu en voletant. {bird:face sad} [sad] « Il me faut des brindilles pour mon nid, mais elles sont toutes trop longues. » {beaver:face happy} [excited] « Laisse-moi faire ! » {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:chomp} Cric, crac, croc : des brindilles juste comme il faut. {bird:face happy} {bird:hop x2} « Parfait ! » {bird:go to branches} Oiseau s’est envolé dans les branches avec ses brindilles et {bird:live sing} {sfx:birdsong} a chanté merci. En bas, les cric-crac s’étaient arrêtés, et {hedgehog:live curl resume} Hérisson a pointé le nez. Autour de lui, les copeaux de Castor étaient tout doux, tout bouclés. {hedgehog:face happy} « Hum, a-t-il dit. Juste comme il faut. » « Cric, crac ? » a demandé Castor. [warmly] « Cric-crac tant que tu veux », a dit Hérisson. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Et {hedgehog:live sleep hold} il s’est pelotonné pour la plus douce des siestes.

it-IT.title: Castoro rosicchia giusto giusto
it-IT.text: Rosic, rosic, ROSIC! {beaver:enter} Castoro era di nuovo all'opera. {beaver:live gnaw} Rosicchiava il suo bastoncino {sfx:chomp} e i trucioli volavano dappertutto… proprio addosso a {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to beaver} Riccio, che cercava di fare un pisolino. {hedgehog:face sad} «Uffa!» {hedgehog:live curl hold} Si è chiuso a palla, tutto pungente e imbronciato. [curious] «Ma perché rosicchi SEMPRE?» {beaver:face surprised} {beaver:wobble} «Perché i miei denti non smettono mai di crescere», ha detto Castoro. «Se non rosicchiassi, mi arriverebbero fino ai piedi!» Proprio allora {bird:enter} {bird:go to beaver} Uccellino è sceso svolazzando. {bird:face sad} [sad] «Mi servono dei rametti per il nido, ma i miei sono tutti troppo lunghi.» {beaver:face happy} [excited] «Ci penso io!» {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:chomp} Rosic, rosic, rosic: rametti giusti giusti. {bird:face happy} {bird:hop x2} «Perfetti!» {bird:go to branches} Uccellino è volato su in alto, tra i rami, con i suoi rametti, e {bird:live sing} {sfx:birdsong} ha cantato il suo grazie. Giù in basso, il rosic rosic si era fermato, e {hedgehog:live curl resume} Riccio ha fatto capolino. Tutto intorno a lui c'erano i trucioli di Castoro, morbidi e arricciati. {hedgehog:face happy} «Mmm», ha detto. «Giusti giusti.» «Rosic, rosic?» ha chiesto Castoro. [warmly] «Rosicchia pure», ha detto Riccio. {hedgehog:face sleeping} E {hedgehog:live sleep hold} si è accoccolato per il pisolino più morbido di tutti.

zh-TW.title: 河狸啃得剛剛好
zh-TW.text: 喀滋、喀滋、喀滋！{beaver:enter}河狸又在啃東西了。{beaver:live gnaw}牠啃著木棍，{sfx:chomp}木屑飛得到處都是……剛好飛到{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to beaver}刺蝟身上，牠正想睡午覺呢。{hedgehog:face sad}「哼！」 {hedgehog:live curl hold}刺蝟氣呼呼地縮成一顆刺球。[curious]「你為什麼老是在啃？」 {beaver:face surprised}{beaver:wobble}「因為我的牙齒一直長、一直長，從來不會停。」 河狸說，「要是不啃，它們會一路長到我的腳趾頭！」 這時，{bird:enter}{bird:go to beaver}小鳥飛了下來。{bird:face sad}[sad]「我要用細枝條蓋鳥巢，可是我找到的都太長了。」 {beaver:face happy}[excited]「交給我吧！」 {beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:chomp}喀滋、喀滋、喀滋，枝條長短剛剛好。{bird:face happy}{bird:hop x2}「太完美了！」 {bird:go to branches}小鳥叼著枝條，飛上高高的樹枝，{bird:live sing}{sfx:birdsong}唱歌謝謝河狸。樹下的喀滋聲停了，{hedgehog:live curl resume}刺蝟探出頭來。牠身邊鋪滿了河狸啃下來的木屑，軟軟的、捲捲的。{hedgehog:face happy}「嗯……」 牠說，「剛剛好。」 「喀滋喀滋？」 河狸問。[warmly]「儘管喀滋喀滋吧。」 刺蝟說。{hedgehog:face sleeping}牠{hedgehog:live sleep hold}窩進木屑裡，睡了一場最軟綿綿的午覺。

zh-HK.title: 海狸咬得啱啱好
zh-HK.text: 咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓！{beaver:enter}海狸又在咬木頭了。{beaver:live gnaw}牠咬着樹枝，{sfx:chomp}木屑四處亂飛……剛好飛到{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to beaver}刺蝟身上，牠正想睡午覺呢。{hedgehog:face sad}「哼！」 {hedgehog:live curl hold}刺蝟氣鼓鼓地縮成一個刺球。[curious]「你點解成日都咬嘢㗎？」 {beaver:face surprised}{beaver:wobble}「因為我啲門牙會一直生，永遠都唔停。」 海狸說，「如果我唔咬，佢哋會一路長到落腳趾公㗎！」 這時，{bird:enter}{bird:go to beaver}小鳥飛了下來。{bird:face sad}[sad]「我想搵啲細枝嚟起竇，但係我搵到嘅全部都太長。」 {beaver:face happy}[excited]「包喺我身上！」 {beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:chomp}咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓，細枝長短啱啱好。{bird:face happy}{bird:hop x2}「啱晒！」 {bird:go to branches}小鳥銜着細枝，飛上高高的樹枝，{bird:live sing}{sfx:birdsong}唱歌多謝海狸。樹下的咔嚓聲停了，{hedgehog:live curl resume}刺蝟探出頭來。牠身邊鋪滿了海狸咬下來的木屑，軟軟的、捲捲的。{hedgehog:face happy}「嗯……」 牠說，「啱啱好。」 「咔嚓咔嚓？」 海狸問。[warmly]「你繼續咔嚓啦。」 刺蝟說。{hedgehog:face sleeping}牠{hedgehog:live sleep hold}鑽進木屑裏，睡了一個最軟綿綿的午覺。
